name: things-mcp
description: Read and write Things 3 tasks, projects, areas and tags from Claude.
long_description: Reads the local Things 3 database directly (read-only SQLite) and writes through the Things URL scheme. Writes need **Things → Settings → General → Enable Things URLs** turned on; without it they silently do nothing. No configuration, no network access: everything stays on your Mac.

tools.name: get_today
tools.description: Get the Today list, grouped like the Things UI.

tools.name: get_upcoming
tools.description: Get tasks scheduled for future dates.

tools.name: get_someday
tools.description: Get the Someday list, including tasks inside Someday projects.

tools.name: get_logbook
tools.description: Get completed and canceled tasks over a time period.

tools.name: get_todos
tools.description: Get all todos, optionally filtered to one project.

tools.name: get_headings
tools.description: Get project headings, optionally scoped to one project.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search todos by text and any combination of filters.

tools.name: add_todos
tools.description: Create one or more todos in a single call.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Create a project, optionally with headings and todos.

tools.name: update_todos
tools.description: Update one or more existing todos in a single call.
